parameters.content:
# Sync Odoo Tags with District Software (Products)
### This node will update Odoo Contacts that have a EVI District number present in the 'EVI_DistID' field.
##### Tags contain product names that a specific district have activated in [EVICore](https://apps.edvistas.com). This workflow query [EVICore](https://apps.edvistas.com)for the most up to date list of Products by District. All contacts in Odoo with a value in the 'EVI_DistID' field will be used in this dataset.

**This is a **Sync** operation so it will add and remove remove tags from odoo that match [EVICore](https://apps.edvistas.com).

parameters.query:
/* All Districts */
SELECT d.id as distId, d.name as district, 
case when isbusiness=1 then 'Business' else 'District' end Product, 
case when isbusiness=1 then '43' else '3' end tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1
UNION

/* Aims Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'Aims' as Product, 71 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join aims..districts a on d.id = a.id
Where t.enabled=1 and a.enabled=1 --and aimsyear >= YEAR(GETDATE())
UNION

/* Bars Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'Bars' as Product, 75 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d 
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.barsDistrict=1 
UNION

/* Curriculum Developer Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'CD' as Product, 74 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join rbemcd..districts r on d.id = r.districtid
Where t.enabled=1 and r.enabled=1 
UNION

/* Datamate Basic Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'DataMate' as Product, 47 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d 
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.dmversion='Basic'
UNION

/* Datamate Live Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'DataMate:Live' as Product, 77 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d 
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.dmversion='Live'
UNION

/* DRP Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'DRP' as Product, 46 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.drpDistrict = 1
UNION

/* EduForm Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'EduForm' as Product, 69 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join eviForms..districts f on d.id = f.id
Where t.enabled=1 and f.enabled=1 
UNION

/* EduView Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'EduView' as Product, 80 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join eduviewEvi..rptDistricts ev on d.id = ev.id
Where t.enabled=1 and ev.disabled=0
UNION

/* Datamate Elite Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'Elite' as Product, 76 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d 
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.datamateElite=1
UNION

/* SafeSchools Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'SafeSchool' as Product, 73 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join safeschools..district ss on d.id = ss.id
Where t.enabled=1 and ss.enabled=1 
UNION

/* Scoring Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'Scoring' as Product, 16 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d 
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and t.nyScoringDistrict = 1
UNION

/* StaffTrac Districts */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'StaffTrac' as Product, 70 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join stafftrac..districts s on d.id = s.id
Where t.enabled=1 and s.enabled=1
UNION

/* Survate */
SELECT d.id, d.name as district, 'Survate' as Product, 81 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
left join eviSurvate..districts sv on d.id = sv.id
Where t.enabled=1 and sv.enabled=1
UNION

/* TransSync Districts */
Select d.id, name as district, 'TransSync' as Product, 82 as tagId
FROM evicore..districts d
left join evitesting..districts t on d.id = t.id
Where t.enabled=1 and enableTransSync=1
